work.title: Software Engineer
work.description: Engineering dnb.com across AEM Cloud, Cloudflare, frontend performance, AI search visibility, developer tooling, and automated quality workflows for a global enterprise platform.
highlights: Replatformed and redesigned 22,000+ dnb.com pages across 17 markets from AEM Managed Services to AEM Cloud by owning dispatcher config, Cloudflare routing, and migration testing for engineering, marketing, legal, and support.

Raised Lighthouse performance scores from approximately 45 to 90 and reduced page-load times by approximately 50% through code splitting, lazy loading, image optimization, SSR improvements, bundle reduction, and Core Web Vitals fixes.
Increased Marketo lead-form conversions by 1-2% across high-traffic marketing pages by improving frontend rendering, page speed, and Core Web Vitals across localized dnb.com experiences.

Cut common AEM debugging workflows from 30-60 minutes to under 5 minutes by building a TypeScript MCP server that connects Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, and Gemini to live logs, metadata validation, page inspection, and environment comparison tools.

Increased AI crawler activity by 10x and improved AI search visibility across OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, and Bing/Copilot by automating llms.txt and llms-full.txt generation, robots.txt updates, metadata, and response headers.

Accelerated DUNS alphanumeric certification from an expected 3-6 months to 1 month by building an AI-assisted testing framework that converted 200+ Zephyr cases into human-reviewed Cypress/Cucumber tests.

work.title: Software Engineering Intern
work.description: Built cloud-native data and AI automation for executive social media and employee sentiment reporting with Google Cloud, Terraform, and Power BI.
highlights: Built a nightly Cloud Run pipeline processing social media and Glassdoor employee data for sentiment analysis, summarization, risk signals, and executive decision support.
Loaded 20,000+ annual data points into Cloud SQL/MySQL to power executive Power BI dashboards, with automated refreshes through Cloud Scheduler, Terraform, and CI/CD.
Reduced manual reporting work by an estimated 5-10 hours per week by automating nightly ingestion, transformation, and dashboard refreshes for executive social media and employee sentiment reporting.
